newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 11 muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 11 muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Florida Board of Regents $13.1 million of housing revenue bonds.
--Midlothian, Ill., $3.2 million of tax and revenue certificates.
--Evergreen Sewer Disposal, Mich., $5.8 million of refunding sewer bonds.
--Newark, N.J., $15.102 million GO water utility bonds.
--Pohatcong Township, N.J., $1.5 million of general improvement bonds.
--Cobleskill-Rich Central School District, N.Y., $9 million GOs.
--Johnsburg CSD, N.Y., $3 million of GO school bonds.
